question: Inside Mr. Cat, is what will happen to who, and where, already decided? Things like ‘In this arc, Al’s helmet will be removed in this situation’. Is it all still vague?
answer: I’m able to say that everything will be in 11 arcs, since it’s already decided, sure. If it wasn’t, what indicator would I have to say 11 arcs? Am I just talking lightly? Well, now that I say that, I am, but I’m not speaking that lightly. What do you know about my vagueness, anyways? Why do you know I’m vague? Are you my mom? Knock when you come in the room!!!
